_comment: Colorado Springs, CO MSA — El Paso and Teller counties. Extracted from the Claude nine-stage workbook (methodology v2.0). IMPORTED 2026-08-03; 13 of 24 live, 11 held. THIS CONFIG CANNOT CURRENTLY BE RUN — see _artifact_lost below.
_artifact_lost: BLOCKER, discovered 2026-08-05. `metro-research/colorado-springs/` DOES NOT EXIST — not the artifact, the whole directory, and the same for colorado-springs-addendum. Both were destroyed by the 2026-08-03 `git clean -fdx` and are unrecoverable: absent from the research repo, from all four nested worktrees, and from git history entirely (`git log --all --diff-filter=A` finds no commit that ever added them). THIS BLOCKS EVERY STAGE, INCLUDING THE TWO THAT NEED NO ARTIFACT. `import-metro-merged.mjs` loads `config.input` at unconditional module scope (`const doc = JSON.parse(readFileSync(INPUT))`), before the stage dispatch — so although `--stage=publish` and `--stage=verify` read only from the database and this config and never touch `doc` or `venues`, both still die with ENOENT. The 2026-08-05 five-metro release therefore shipped little-rock/pensacola/el-paso and DEFERRED this metro and its addendum. OWNER RULING 2026-08-05: do not work around it — no lazy-load patch to the shared importer (its module scope also runs the exclude, same_site_pairs and RECONCILE validations off `venues`, and this config has 2 reconciles, so an empty array trips the stale-config abort), and no reconstructing the artifact from the database (circular: --stage=listings would read that file on any future rebuild, and the pipeline's assertions would be checking rows against a file derived from those same rows). Colorado Springs is queued for a v3 source-led re-research, same treatment as McAllen: a fresh pass rebuilds the artifact and is expected to find more than the 24 here. The 17 live rows across both batches stay live throughout and were not touched by the 2026-08-05 run.

_v3_reresearch_findings._note: Surfaced at the 2026-08-05 go-gate while assessing the 9 rows the ADR-16/17 gate change would have released. Recorded here because the v3 re-research pass is where they will actually be met, and they would otherwise evaporate between sessions. NONE of these blocked the release — it was deferred on the lost artifact above. The owner's stated caveats were both confirmed accurate: 5 of the 9 cite pppall.net/Outdoor with no per-venue URL, and 3 (cheyenne-mountain-country-club, glen-park, westmoor-park) have NULL addresses geocoded from a name match alone.
_v3_reresearch_findings.coordinates_are_NOT_the_brubaker_failure: Checked specifically, because a name-matched coordinate with no address is how Brubaker Park went wrong. These are not that. glen-park-palmer-lake-co sits 879 m from Palmer Lake's centre — right town — on an OSM place=hamlet node named 'Glen Park', labelled `low`, so ADR-16's approximate-location banner covers it honestly. westmoor-park anchored on `park way/207700135 "Westmoor Park"` and cheyenne-mountain-country-club on `social way/220300890 "Cheyenne Mountain Country Club"` — both exact name matches onto the correct entity type. Right entity, right town, honest labels. The weakest of the three is glen-park: a hamlet centroid standing in for a park, with no address to cross-check it against.
_v3_reresearch_findings.cheyenne_mountain_cites_a_different_osm_: cheyenne-mountain-country-club-colorado-springs-co carries `name_source_url = https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1470162223` while its coordinate was derived from `way/220300890` — a DIFFERENT OSM object. So the identity citation and the coordinate do not even point at the same feature. More fundamentally, OSM is the coordinate layer, not an identity source: this row's existence rests on a map object, cited from a second map object that is not the one used. It is also a members-only country club (`access_type='membership'`). The v3 pass should either find a controlling-entity source for it or drop it; do not publish it on this evidence.
_v3_reresearch_findings.would_be_the_sites_first_row_on_both_hos: Measured against production 2026-08-05: ZERO published rows site-wide cite pppall.net or openstreetmap.org in `name_source_url` (0 of 937 at the time; 0 of 965 after the release). Both hosts appear only on drafts — 6 pppall.net, 2 openstreetmap.org. Publishing this batch as-is would make Colorado Springs the first published metro on both, 5 rows and 1 row respectively. That is permitted under ADR-17 coverage-first once the rows are tiered `listed` (they now are — see _adr18_retier), but it is a first rather than a continuation of established practice, and worth a deliberate decision rather than arriving as a side effect.
_v3_reresearch_findings._adr18_retier: All 10 `probable` rows in this batch were re-tiered `source_verified` -> `listed` on 2026-08-05 (scripts/retier-adr18-debt.mjs), so the batch now satisfies the ADR-18 assertion in --stage=verify and is ready to publish the moment an artifact exists again. The 1 `verified` draft and the 13 live rows were untouched.

_envelope_comment: Derived from the Colorado Springs MSA county list (El Paso + Teller), not the observed venue bounding box, so a legitimate future venue near the metro edge is not rejected.
msa: Colorado Springs, CO (El Paso and Teller counties)
_exclude_comment: No exclusions. The 10 probable rows are NOT excluded — they import as draft and are held by the publish gate on research_status, which is the intended mechanism.
_geocode_comment: 5 of 24 produce no coordinate from any rung and 4 more resolve only to street/city level. All 9 were investigated, not waved through: 5 carry no street address at all in the workbook (Widefield Community Park, Garden of the Gods Resort & Club, YMCA at First & Main, Windmill Mesa Park, The Warehouse via a suite address), and the low-precision 4 geocode to a street band. All 9 are blocked by the publish gate, which is correct. require_all_geocoded stays false so the batch can import as draft while those are resolved.
_reconcile_comment: 2 reconciles onto pre-existing dormant OSM draft rows. Both are draft, unverified, metro_area NULL, and predate this session. Site-wide facility_listings delta must therefore be exactly +22, not +24.

reconciles.note: STRONGEST RECONCILE IN THIS SET. Exact-address anchor: the existing OSM row already carries address 2975 New Center Point, city Colorado Springs, zip 80922 — byte-identical to the operator-published address on springspickleball.com. Independent Nominatim geocode of that address lands 10 m from the stored OSM node. Research supplies what the OSM row lacks: court_count 11, access_type private (the row currently says unknown, which FAILS the publish gate), fee_type fee, reservation_policy and booking URL. Name normalises from the OSM hyphenation "Springs Pickleball - East" to the operator form "Springs Pickleball East"; slug is unchanged either way, so no live URL moves.

Exact-ID anchor: both rows are the SAME OSM node (node/10799702072), so distance is 0 by construction and identity is not in question. RENAME REQUIRED: the OSM name "Colo Spgs Pickleball "The Warehouse" (Indoor Court)" carries an abbreviation, embedded quotes and a parenthetical, and its slug colo-spgs-pickleball-the-warehouse-indoor-court-co lacks the -city-state convention every published row uses. The research name "Colorado Springs Pickleball (The Warehouse)" produces a convention-correct slug. The row is draft and has never been published, so no live URL moves. access_type currently unknown, which FAILS the publish gate; research supplies private. Row is research_status=probable and will be held by the gate regardless — the operator About page 404s.

_expected_publish_comment: Locked 2026-08-03 from the --stage=project run after the geocode repair pass; REASONS UPDATED 2026-08-06 after the owner ruled this batch stays at 13. The 13/11 SPLIT IS UNCHANGED and always was the intent — what changed is WHY nine of the eleven are held. They were held by `research_status=probable`; ADR-16/17 plus the ADR-18 re-tier stopped blocking on that, and a --stage=project run on 2026-08-06 accordingly projected 22/24. They are now held by `research_status=held`, set deliberately on the candidate rows so a future gate change cannot release them silently. This block tracks a DELIBERATE CHANGE OF STATE; it was not edited to make a divergence go away, and the split it asserts is the same 13/11 it has always asserted.
_expected_publish_format_warning: HOLD VALUES ARE SHORT MACHINE REASONS, NOT PROSE. The assertion is a substring-containment check against the importer's own generated reason string, so an explanatory sentence fails a split that is actually correct — it has cost two metros (Jacksonville: 7 false failures). Every value below is a literal fragment the importer itself emits. Rationale lives in _hold_rationale, never here.

_hold_rationale._note: Why each row is held. Prose belongs HERE, not in expected_publish.hold. Owner ruling 2026-08-06: default is hold; publishing requires evidence. The gate loosening is why these would now pass — it is not evidence that they should.
_hold_rationale._five_rows_on_one_club_page: banning-lewis-ranch, glen-park, wasson-high-school, westmoor-park and wildflower-park all rest solely on pppall.net/Outdoor, so their apparent corroboration is one link. NOTE for accuracy: `website` is NULL on all five, so that URL is NOT written into a user-facing column and no ADR-14 assertion fires. This is an editorial-quality hold, not a rule violation — which is precisely why it needed an owner ruling rather than an assertion.
_hold_rationale.cheyenne-mountain-country-club-colorado-: Cites OSM way/1470162223 as its IDENTITY source while its coordinate came from way/220300890 — a different object. Worse, THE NAME DESIGNATES NO ENTITY: the venue is The Country Club of Colorado at Cheyenne Mountain Resort, 125 E Clubhouse Dr, 80906 (8 outdoor + 1 indoor courts, operator-sourced). Needs rename + address + operator source, not release.
_hold_rationale.wasson-high-school-colorado-springs-co: Coordinate anchors 'Roy J. Wasson Academic Campus'. Wasson High School CLOSED at the end of 2012-13; the site is now a District 11 alternative/adult-education campus (rjwac.d11.org). That is why the 2026-08-03 pass could find no D11 source — it was looking for a school that no longer exists. Publishing ships a defunct name sourced to a club list.
_hold_rationale.bonforte-park-colorado-springs-co: Cites coloradosprings.gov/parks/page/tennis-and-pickleball — a tier-1 municipal page that DOES NOT NAME IT. The venue is real (the city's neighborhood-parks page lists it at 2323 N Wahsatch Ave with two tennis courts), but the URL on the row does not support the claim.
_hold_rationale.portal-park-colorado-springs-co: Same unsupporting city URL as bonforte-park, PLUS an address conflict: the row says 1216 Devonshire St, the city's neighborhood-parks page says 3535 N Hancock Ave with four tennis courts. The stored coordinate sits at the city's location, so it is the address column that is wrong.
_hold_rationale.wildflower-park-colorado-springs-co: UNRESOLVED CONTRADICTION, the only one this pass could neither confirm nor clear. pppall lists 1 dual-striped tennis court at 980 Nolte Dr West; the city's neighborhood-parks entry lists baseball, soccer, basketball/in-line skate, picnic shelter and playground — and NO tennis court at all.
_hold_rationale._three_null_addresses: cheyenne-mountain-country-club, glen-park and westmoor-park were geocoded from a name match with no address at all. This pass FOUND addresses for all three — 125 E Clubhouse Dr; Lovers Lane, Palmer Lake 80133 (no house number is published, so none was invented); 3315 Water St — but NONE of them is in the database. Finding a source is not applying one.
_hold_rationale.springs-pickleball-west-colorado-springs: THE ONE ROW HELD WITHOUT AN EVIDENCE PROBLEM. Sourced to its operator springspickleball.com and independently re-confirmed this pass. It was only ever held on coordinate precision (780 Vondelpark Dr resolves to the road band), which ADR-16 now releases behind an approximate-location label. It is held here solely because releasing it means running this batch's publish stage, which releases every eligible row in it. Best candidate for the first per-row release.
_hold_rationale.windmill-mesa-park-colorado-springs-co: No coordinate — an unchanged mechanical block, not an owner hold. Operated by Widefield School District 3 at 4610 Fencer Rd, 80911. WARNING: a successful re-geocode releases it, because nothing else is holding it.
_hold_rationale.colorado-springs-pickleball-the-warehous: No coordinate — also mechanical, and carrying a LATENT HAZARD: its name_source_url is a pickleheads.com aggregator URL, so a re-geocode would both release it and trip the ADR-14 abort. Its operator domain cspickleball.com now serves gambling/affiliate spam, so it has no citable source at all. RECOMMEND setting research_status='held' rather than leaving it protected only by a missing coordinate.
